//RainRite: The rain rite's cool-down (plan section 26, pack Prompt 35): a hidden self-timed stat in the shape of hw_stat_venom with NO status. Its only writer is the athame's Call Rain actions, which add +192 (HW_RAIN_COOLDOWN, this stat's max); the base rate of -1 drains it a tick at a time, so two days, and the actions only show while it reads 0. It writes no player stat. RequiredStatValues FAILS OPEN if this UID were misspelt, so the [rituals] gate asserts the UID names this file. A TUNABLE PLACEHOLDER.

Description.DefaultText: Hidden timer: how many ticks until the rain rite can be done again.
